bio.text: Anne Stava is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 81st District, serving since January 2019, according to the Illinois General Assembly.
Stava's legislature biography says Stava is a graduate of Dartmouth College and a former commissioner on the Naperville Board of Fire and Police.
It says Stava worked as a consumer researcher for corporations before working in government.
